card.name: Comma after parenteral inspection sentence
card.fires_on: The comma right after "prior to administration" in the standard sentence that parenteral drug products should be inspected for particulate matter and discoloration. It comes just before "whenever solution and container permit".

modes.label: Inspection sentence comma
modes.description: Comma after "prior to administration" in the stock parenteral inspection statement.
modes.example: Parenteral drug products should be inspected visually for particulate matter and discoloration prior to administration<<,>> whenever solution and container permit.

card.plain: It fires on the comma in the familiar label sentence about checking injectable products for particles and color change before use.
